mechanics_revision: M03 (see mechanics workstream; dimensions and limits require its released drawings)

channels.purpose: actual sampled electrical input reference; never force
local water-pressure sensor chain; pressure only after scoped sensitivity conversion
direct bridge vibration reference along declared axis
channels.required_for: separating electrical drive drift from moving boundary response

channels.purpose: optional actual dynamic input force at structure-side coupling
channels.required_for: pressure/force or mechanical force FRF; absent in minimum build
slow loading baseline and measured writer-port work
slow position hold and loop closure

candidate_diagnostics_not_success_thresh: electrical loopback gain/phase and channel swap
rod out vs in with matched other conditions
tank empty vs water at indexed fill
none vs rigid dummy vs reference viscoelastic vs clay
at least three reader amplitudes within measured displacement limits
repeat identical stationary windows before/after each write
independent geometry and mass observations before/after write
fixed-gain vs deliberately changed recording gain control
slow unloaded baseline before/after, rigid fixture compliance and writer hold

feature_semantics.audio_ratios: digital channel ratios until end-to-end calibration
feature_semantics.pressure_per_voltage: valid calibrated system response if chain/phase/environment scope holds; not pressure per force
feature_semantics.pressure_per_acceleration: boundary transmission at specified two ports, not full material modulus
feature_semantics.pressure_per_force: requires separately measured actual dynamic force
feature_semantics.slow_work: sampled writer-port work, not isolated clay dissipation
feature_semantics.memory: fixed-coefficient SLS transfer does not identify initial memory coordinate; no retained-memory inference from one FRF

gates.G0_identity: raw hashes, sensor/settings/mount and units recorded
gates.G1_electrical: electrical paths checked before exciter connection
gates.G2_dry_mechanical: rod out; low-amplitude dry/reference checks; dynamic diaphragm/boss motion release gate remains blocked until separately qualified
gates.G3_water_path: vented static fill; hydrophone mount verified; rod out/in checks; read limit assessed at diaphragm/boss port
gates.G5_combined_read_after_write: reader repeatability, stationarity and state-change checks supplied to task owner
gates.G6_experimental_claim: external theorem/success-criterion workstream owns claim and preregistered thresholds

dynamic_read_release_gate.quantity: dynamic diaphragm/boss displacement about wet equilibrium
dynamic_read_release_gate.acceptable_evidence: independently calibrated dynamic boss measurement OR validated bridge-to-boss kinematic transfer with uncertainty
dynamic_read_release_gate.not_accepted: DAC level, slow50scan/s position trace, unqualified acceleration integration, ADC code size or nominal laser accuracy

clock_and_filter_obligations.audio_frequency_axis: ADC nominal seconds until independently calibrated to SI seconds
